instruction: A crisp athletic photograph shows a medium shot in a boxing gym. On the left, the blonde woman in the purple cropped hoodie (R2) stands facing right, extending her left arm. On the right, the black man in the orange beanie (R1) stands facing her, actively instructing. He holds her brown boxing glove with his hand to adjust her punching form while gesturing with his other hand. The background features a gray concrete wall with a painted boxer graphic and a black punching bag on the left. The lighting is bright and even, capturing the focused training interaction between the coach and the athlete.
